fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-02-06 states that a dual-SIM handset was allegedly snatched from the hand of Naveen Balan at Amudham Nagar Main Street by a person who left quickly, on 2025-02-05 at about 06:10. Elango Balan (9000000036) reported the matter for Naveen Balan, whose contact number is given as 9000000277. Jeeva Natarajan (mobile 9000000002) was named as a possible person of interest. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant mentioned a call detail reference and mobile phone records.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Call detail reference; Mobile phone record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Handset reportedly snatched while the victim was using it near the roadside.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, mobile number, phone records, call detail, suspect, main street, early morning
